mercimek.name: Suugada Digirta
mercimek.description: Suugada digirta ee guriga lagu sameeyo oo loo diyaariyey qaabkii caadiga ahaa, iyadoo lagu daray suugo subag leh.

tas-kebabi.name: Suugada Lo'aanka Turkiga
tas-kebabi.description: Lo'aanka, khudaarta xilliga, iyo suugada gaarka ah ee makhaayaddeena si tartiib ah loo karsaday.

kuzu-tandir.name: Soonka Ido La Fooxay
kuzu-tandir.description: Ido tandoori ah oo astaan u ah makhaayaddeena, si tartiib ah loogu kariyey kulayl hoose.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Baastada Bariiska
pirinc-pilavi.description: Baastada Bariiska Baldo ee subag leh oo hawo leh.

firin-sutlac.name: Kubbadka Bariiska ee la Dubay
firin-sutlac.description: Kubbad bariis ah oo la dubay sida dhaqanka ah, oo loo diyaariyey caano buffalo oo maalinle ah.

kuru-fasulye.name: Stew Digirta Caddaan ah oo Hilib Lo'aad leh
kuru-fasulye.description: Digir İspir, hilib lo'aad la jarjaray, iyo suugo yaanyo oo maqaayad ah.

izgara-kofte.name: Kubadaha Hilibka La Dubay
izgara-kofte.description: Kubadaha hilibka lo'aad ee qaabka kalluumaysatada oo leh basbaas la dubay iyo yaanyo.

ayran.name: Ayran La Ruxay
ayran.description: Karrito dhaqameed oo la ruxay oo leh cajaa'ib badan, laga sameeyay caano farmaajo maalinle ah.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Shorba Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Shorba dhaqameed oo maqaayad ah halkaas oo digir cas, bulgur, iyo bariis ay kula kulmaan mint.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Shorba Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana guri lagu sameeyey, oo klassik Anatolian ah oo si tartiib ah loo kariyey iyadoo lala socdo yaanyo iyo mint qalalan.

yayla-corbasi.name: Suugada Yogurt iyo Bariis
yayla-corbasi.description: Suugo yayla ah oo qabow oo kareemo leh oo lagu diyaariyey yogurt, bariis, iyo dux la qalajiyey.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Suugada Caloosha Lo'da
iskembe-corbasi.description: Suugo caloosha lo'da sax ah oo laguugu keenayo dhadhankeeda iyo khal toon ah.

dugun-corbasi.name: Suugada Arooska
dugun-corbasi.description: Suugada arooska dhaqameed oo lagu sameeyey hilib adhiga jeexan oo lagu dhadhansiiyey marinade liin ah.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Suugada Maraqa Digaaga
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Suugo bogsiin ah oo lagu diyaariyey baasto dhuuban oo ku jirta maraq lafta iyo hilib digaag jeexan.

domates-corbasi.name: Suugada Yaanyada
domates-corbasi.description: Dhadhan hodan ah oo lagu kariyey yaanyo bisil, subag, iyo basbaas, laguna dhameystiray farmaajo.

sebze-corbasi.name: Maraq Khudrad
sebze-corbasi.description: Maraq fudud oo maqaayad lagu diyaariyay oo lagu sameeyay khudrado xilliyeed, saliid saytuun, iyo dhir cusub.

beyran-corbasi.name: Maraq Lo'aad Beyran oo Qadhaadh
beyran-corbasi.description: Maraq goboleed oo lagu diyaariyay kulayl aad u sarreeya oo ka kooban lo', bariis, toon, iyo basbaaska kulul.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Maraq Madaxa iyo Lugaha Lo'da
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Maraq hodan ah oo ka samaysan lafaha lugaha lo'da iyo hilibka madaxa oo saacado badan la kariyay.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Maraq Miiro
sehriye-corbasi.description: Isku-darka maalinlaha ee maraq digaag oo leh yaanyo, baasto fidsan, iyo basbaas cagaaran.

tavuk-sis.name: Shish-ka Digaaga
tavuk-sis.description: Qaybo digaag ah oo lagu mariyey xawaash gaar ah, laguugu keenayo basbaas la dubay iyo yaanyo.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucukka Doobka la Dubay
kasap-sucuk.description: Kalluunka lo'da ee kulul oo lagu kariyey dhuxul, oo leh khudaar la dubay iyo basal oo sumac leh.

karisik-izgara.name: Grill Isku-dhafan
karisik-izgara.description: Saxan badan oo kala duwan oo ka kooban kubbado hilib ah, shish-ka digaag, laamb farmaajo, iyo kaluunka.

nohut-yemegi.name: Hilibka Xoolaha ee Isku-dhafan ee Digir
nohut-yemegi.description: Cunto guri lagu sameeyo oo ka kooban chickpeas iyo hilib lo'aad oo la jarjaray oo si tartiib ah loogu kariyo digsi naxaas ah.

patlican-musakka.name: Baasto Moussaka
patlican-musakka.description: Baasto la shiilay, hilib lo'aad la dhulka maray, iyo moussaka oo lagu dubay foornada iyadoo lagu daray suugada yaanyada, qaab maqaayadeed.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Digir-cagaaran oo saliid saytuun ku jirta
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Qadiimi, lagu kariyey saliid saytuun leh digir-cagaaran, yaanyo, iyo basal, oo si qabow loo bixiyo.

tavuk-sote.name: Faraanti digaag la shiilay
tavuk-sote.description: Qaybaha digaaga waxaa lagu shiilaa kulayl sare oo leh basbaas midab leh, mushroom, iyo yaanyo.

izmir-kofte.name: Boorso hilib ah oo qaab İzmir ah
izmir-kofte.description: Weedho dhaqameed oo ka kooban kubbado hilib lo'aad ah, baradho, iyo basbaas lagu dubay maraqa yaanyada.

etli-bezelye.name: Bariis digir leh iyo Hilib Lo'aad
etli-bezelye.description: Cunto maalinle ah oo lagu kariyo digsi leh hilib lo'aad oo la jarjaray, digir, karootada, iyo baradho.

patlican-oturtma.name: Berengal la dubay oo leh Hilib la shiiday
patlican-oturtma.description: Lafaha afka waxaa lagu diyaariyaa foornada iyadoo lala dubayo berengel, hilib la shiiday oo basbaas leh, iyo maraqa yaanyada toonta leh.

salgam-suyu.name: Waxaa Shukumaan La hoos geliyey
salgam-suyu.description: Shukumaan kulul oo dhaqameed oo lagu hoos geliyey karootada guduudan iyo khamiirka bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Biyaha Macdanta
maden-suyu.description: Biyo macdan dabiici ah oo la qaboojiyey oo fudud.

su.name: Biyaha Ilkaha Dabiiciga ah
su.description: Biyo ilaha dabiiciga ah oo lagu qaboojiyey dhalo galaas ah.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: Cabbitaan karboon leh oo classic ah oo lagu qaboojiyey baraf.

gazoz.name: Liin Soodha Turkiga
gazoz.description: Soodha dhaqameed oo dhadhan wanaagsan leh, refreshing ah, oo lagu qaboojiyey si fudud.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kafe Turkiga
turk-kahvesi.description: Kafe dhaqameed Turkiga ah oo leh xumbo, oo lagu kariyey kulayl sare gudaha biraha qadaadiicda ah ee copper-ka.

demleme-cay.name: Shaaha la kariyey ee Turkiga
demleme-cay.description: Shaah kulul oo cusub oo Rize ah oo lagu shubay galaas dhuuban oo dhexdiisu ciriiri yahay.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Limo qoyan oo guriga lagu sameeyay
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Lemoade cusub oo la diyaariyo maalin kasta iyadoo la isticmaalayo liin cusub, minti, iyo sonkor yar.

hosaf.name: Kombobka Miraha Maalinlaha ah
hosaf.description: Kombob guriga lagu sameeyo oo la karkariyo maalin kasta iyadoo la isticmaalayo canabka, abrikot, ama muuska iyadoo loo eegayo xilliga.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Hilibka ayaa lagu rogaa shid la safeeyey oo lagu dul saaraa pide, waxaa lagu adeegaa suugo yaanyo, subag kulul, iyo caano fadhi.

kazandibi.name: Caano Karamelaysan oo Budin
kazandibi.description: Macmacaanka caanaha dhaqameed oo si habboon loo karamelseeyay, leh texture jilicsan.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Caano Budin Cusmaani
tavuk-gogsu.description: Macmacaan caano khafiif ah oo fiber leh oo lagu diyaariyey cunto dhaqameed, waxaa lagu soo bandhigay cinnamon.

keskul.name: Pudding Caano Laws
keskul.description: Macmacaan caano qaabkii Ottoman-ka oo lagu dhammaystiray dhadhan laws ah iyo loos-buurow.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva semolina, la dubay subag iyo lows, waxaa lagu soo bandhigay kulul oo qaro weyn.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Macmacaan Boorashka leh Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Boorashka, si tartiib ah loogu kariyey casiirkiisa, waxaa lagu soo bandhigay tahini iyo lows.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Macmacaan Ilma-Gabow
ayva-tatlisi.description: Ilma-gabow lagu kariyey xanjeb iyo cinnamon waxaa lagu soo bandhigay kareem cufan iyo lows.

revani.name: Keki Malaxa Semolina
revani.description: Macmacaan caadi ah oo maqaayad lagu cuno halkaasoo keki jilicsan oo semolina ah uu la kulmo malax dhadhan liin leh.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudding Rooti oo leh Kareem la Clotted gareeyay
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudding rooti oo ku nastay malax karameleysan waxaa laguugu adeegi doonaa kareem la Clotted gareeyay oo Buffalo ah.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava Kokob
cevizli-baklava.description: Lakabyo aad u dhuuban oo la dulqaday, baklava macdan leh oo dheer oo laga sameeyay kookob badan iyo subag caadi ah.
